name: github-status-policy
description: Publish GitHub commit status or check run for the resolved commit after push.

post-push.description: Publish a GitHub status or check run for the resolved commit.

summary.default: Rexo reported test and coverage results.

steps.run: if [ "{{options.dry-run}}" = "true" ]; then echo DRY RUN: would create GitHub check run '{{options.name}}' for commit {{version.CommitSha}}; elif [ "{{options.mode}}" = "checks" ] || ( [ "{{options.mode}}" = "auto" ] && [ "{{env.GITHUB_ACTIONS}}" != "true" ] ); then REPO=${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:-$(gh repo view --json nameWithOwner -q .nameWithOwner)} && gh api repos/$REPO/check-runs -f name='{{options.name}}' -f head_sha='{{version.CommitSha}}' -f status=completed -f conclusion='{{options.conclusion}}' -f output.title='{{options.title}}' -f output.summary='{{options.summary}}'; fi

if [ "{{options.dry-run}}" = "true" ]; then echo DRY RUN: would publish GitHub status '{{options.context}}'={{options.state}} for commit {{version.CommitSha}}; elif [ "{{options.mode}}" = "status" ]; then REPO=${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:-$(gh repo view --json nameWithOwner -q .nameWithOwner)} && gh api repos/$REPO/statuses/{{version.CommitSha}} -f state={{options.state}} -f context="{{options.context}}" -f description="{{options.description}}"; fi
